verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own venture capital page says it advises on equity investments "through the full series of equity funding rounds" to exit. The TwoVenture hub spans Start & Seed through Scale & Growth stages. The only deal volume stated is a dated, London-only figure (over 150 VC deals in 2017), and no representative transactions are named, so the volume/transactions half of the story is only thinly met. missing for 10: named representative transactions, current firm-wide deal volume (the stated figure is 2017 and London-only), explicit documentation of late-stage priced rounds, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages
